summary: 10 tag-concepts (GPU, 27B teacher) — net-new tradition, tag all three fully
description: Node 10 (tag-concepts). Consequence: single-instance (the 4B --parallel path does not apply), slower, and it reads the live taxonomy in-prompt so it may propose NEW biblical taxonomy concepts (taxonomy expansion) — those land in the node-11 queue like any tag. IDs are 71xxx (27B), not 70xxx. Thinking ON (serve-llama.sh routes reasoning_content). Tag all three books at normal density INCLUDING Genesis 12-50 — no hand-pruning; noise culled at node 11. ANNOUNCE GPU + llm stop when done; launch the run via ~/.local/bin/agent-run. DONE: staged_tags (71xxx) for each book; Genesis all 50 ch tagged; qbatch accept counts verified.
